style.styleTitle: Scottish Everlastings Ltd Christmas Satin Bow Garland
style.toneOfVoice: Bring vibrant festive charm to your home with this 180cm satin bow garland in a striking red, pink, and orange colourway. Featuring a series of beautifully tied satin bows, it adds a playful yet elegant touch to your Christmas décor. Perfect for draping across mantels, staircases, doorways, or windows, this garland instantly brightens any space with its rich, joyful hues. The luxurious satin finish catches the light, creating a subtle shimmer that adds sophistication to your seasonal displays. Lightweight and easy to style, it offers endless decorating possibilities—whether layered with greenery, paired with candles, or displayed on its own for a bold statement. Add a splash of colour and a festive flourish with this eye-catching 180cm satin bow garland. Bring indoors during adverse weather conditions.  Garland Length: L180cm.
